source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Long-term prevention of symptoms, with fairly little role in providing acute relief during a flare-up","B":"Daily maintenance therapy alone, rather than being used for acute symptom relief as needed","C":"A medication generally considered to carry fairly little established role in asthma management overall","D":"Acute rescue treatment during sudden respiratory symptoms, given its rapid onset of action"}}
source_row.rationale: Short-acting beta agonists like albuterol are used for acute rescue treatment during sudden respiratory symptoms, given their rapid onset of action, distinct from long-acting agents used for daily maintenance therapy.
source_row.source_detail: SABA Use for Acute Symptom Relief
